pointer.description: Validation harness for Non-Trailblazing Session Tracking specification

content: Validation harness that verifies session tracking works correctly for non-trailblazing (deterministic) tasks in the activity execution system. Checks that executionEvidence.sessionsSpawned array is populated with all required fields after activity completion.

usage.programmatic: import { runValidation } from './tests/validation-harnesses/non-trailblazing-session-tracking-harness'; const result = await runValidation(input);
